slides.say: Before the clips, the part that matters most. None of this was invented here. MoonLight is built on the work of the people on this slide: the WLED and FastLED communities, the driver authors who worked out how to clock thousands of lights from one chip, and the artists whose shader and effect vocabulary the whole LED world now speaks. Every one of them is credited in the source file that carries their idea, next to the code it shaped. Take a moment if you want to read it.

slides.say: And the algorithms. These are the textbook ones, by name, because using the standard solution under its standard name is a principle here rather than an accident: anyone who knows the field recognises what the code is doing, and can check whether we got it right. Drawing, noise, fluids, raymarching, particle physics, meter ballistics, the network protocols. Not one of them is ours. What is ours is the way they fit together.
